Bug_Title: NP: Method does not check for null argument (NP_ARGUMENT_MIGHT_BE_NULL)
Bug_Details:
A parameter to this method has been identified as a value that should
always be checked to see whether or not it is null, but it is being dereferenced
without a preceding null check.
Bug_Explanation: The method 'doSomething' is supposed to check if 'arg' is null before dereferencing it, but it does not. The call to doSomething(arg) in the'showBug' method will throw a NullPointerException.
Trigger_Explanation: The purpose of the generated JUNIT test case is to trigger the bug where the doSomething and showBug methods do not check if their arguments are null before dereferencing them. This will result in a NullPointerException being thrown when the methods are called with null arguments.
